subject: Aaron Olapade School Committee Candidacy
overview: Incumbent School Committee member Aaron Olapade presents his qualifications and platform for reelection. He highlights his record on school funding, facility modernization, and equity initiatives within Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Candidate Statement
items.summary: Aaron Olapade outlines his work on the 2024 budget overrides, the High School Building Committee, and the implementation of programs including Best Buddies and district-wide composting. He advocates for a school committee that reflects the diversity of its students and supports expanded vocational and career-ready pathways.
